plan.notes: Official University of Oregon 2026-2027 catalog, Bachelor of Science in Biology sample Four-Year Degree Plan. The catalog states the plan is a sample; students consult advisors. Terms are Fall/Winter/Spring quarters (12 terms; UO is a quarter-system school). Declared catalog total 182; recorded total_credits=182 is the exact sum of transcribed credits. MAPS = department's upper-division biology breadth areas as labeled in the catalog map.
